intro_html: Keeps the permits, licences and certificates your people have to keep current out of the spreadsheet nobody opens — one record each, with its scan and its dates, and a daily run that emails the holder and puts a to-do on their manager before the date passes, instead of the week after.

features.title: Every Document, One Record
features.desc: A work permit, a driving licence, a first-aid certificate — each with its own reference number, its issue and expiry dates, and its scan attached to the record.

features.title: Four Ways To Chase
features.desc: On the expiry date, once a set number of days before, every day up to it, or every day after. Choose per document type; the daily run follows it.

features.title: The Holder And The Manager
features.desc: Every chase emails the employee and puts a to-do on their manager, dated on the expiry day. An open to-do is refreshed, never duplicated.

features.title: Renew Without Losing The Old
features.desc: Renewal asks for new dates, a new scan and a reason, then moves the superseded scans onto a history row rather than overwriting them.

features.title: One Valid Document Per Type
features.desc: Enforced in the database as well as the form, so two simultaneous imports cannot slip a duplicate through. Drafts and expired copies may coexist.

features.title: Read The List, Not The Dates
features.desc: Expired rows are red, drafts are greyed, and the Days Remaining column says Expired 20 days, Today, Tomorrow, or a plain number.

features.title: Nobody Reads A Colleague's Permit
features.desc: An ordinary employee sees their own documents and no one else's — not through the list, and not by opening the address directly.

features.title: Blank Forms To Hand Out
features.desc: Expense claims, change-of-address notifications, equipment loan agreements: the paperwork everyone asks HR for, kept beside the documents you track.

limitations: No approval workflow. An HR officer marks a document valid alone; nobody countersigns it.
No employee self-service. Employees read their own documents but cannot upload a scan or start a renewal — HR does both.
An expired document raises a flag, it does not block. Scheduling, payroll and leave carry on.
No OCR. Scans are stored as attachments, so expiry dates are always typed in by hand.
No escalation ladder. One email to the employee and one to-do for the direct manager; nothing goes further up if both are ignored.
No printable register. There is no PDF of the document list.
Odoo's own passport and work-permit fields on the employee are left alone — a document recorded here is a separate record, by design.
Reminders depend on Odoo's scheduled action running. If the cron is disabled, nothing expires and nothing is chased.
